pv44:1.1: Gūthakūpato uggantvā kā nu dīnā patiṭṭhasi nissaṃsayaṃ pāpakammantā kin nu saddahase tuvaṃ. || || Ahaṃ
pv44:2.1: bhadante petī 'mhi duggatā Yamalokikā pāpakammaṃ karitvāna petalokam ito gatā. || || Kin
pv44:3.1: nu kāyena vācāya manasā dukkaṭaṃ kaṭaṃ kissa kammavipākena idaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchasi. || ||
pv44:4.1: Ahu āvāsiko mayhaṃ issukī kulamaccharī ajjhosito mayhaṃ ghare kadariyo paribhāsako. || ||
pv44:5.1: Tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā bhikkhavo paribhāsisaṃ tassa kammavipākena petalokam ito gatā. || || Amitto
pv44:6.1: mittavaṇṇena yo te āsi kulūpako kāyassa bhedā duppañño kin nu pecca gatiṃ gato. || || Tass'
pv44:7.1: evāhaṃ pāpakammassa sīse tiṭṭhāmi matthake so ca paravisayaṃ patto mam' eva paricārako. || ||
pv44:8.1: Yaṃ bhadante hadant' aññe etaṃ me hoti bhojanaṃ ahañ ca kho yaṃ hadāmi etaṃ so upajīvati. || ||
